title: Currents of Perception
subtitle: A second pass on Constructivism and Surrealism — this time thinking about perception itself.

tiles: Continuing my reading on both movements
challenge: After the first Constructivism/Surrealism set, I kept thinking about how both movements were really interested in perception — how we see and what our minds do with what we see. I wanted to make a set that was more directly about that.
approach: I went back into the reading, this time paying more attention to the perceptual and psychological side of both movements, and drafted variations where figures quietly emerge from the geometry itself. I kept the ones that felt like they were doing something to the eye in a way I found interesting.
result: A smaller, stranger set that I'm pleased with. They're available as prints for anyone who likes an image that rewards a second look.
